member.name: M:DemiCode.Scheduling.Schedules.Test.IntervalScheduleTest.ChangeSystemClockDuringIntervalTest
member.summary:
This test is ment to excercise what happens if the system clock is changed during an interval. If the clock is moved forward, eg 1 second, the observed events will fire as expected and SignalTime will be "correct". ActualSignalTime +1 second and the real difference between the previous and next event will be reduced by 1 second.
If the clock is moved back one second, the observed events will for that interval seem to fire twice at one event, thus the SignalTime will be equal for two consequtive events. The ActualSignalTime will be -1 second compared to the expected time and the real difference between the previous and next event will be reduced by 1 second.

member.name: M:DemiCode.Scheduling.Schedules.Test.IntervalScheduleTest.DaylightSavingCrossingTest
member.summary:
In the U.S., clocks change at 2:00 a.m. local time. In spring, clocks spring forward from 1:59 a.m. to 3:00 a.m.; in fall, clocks fall back from 1:59 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
In the EU, clocks change at 1:00 a.m. Universal Time. In spring, clocks spring forward from 12:59 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.; in fall, clocks fall back from 1:59 a.m. to 1:00 a.m.
